info.title: Robis API
info.description: Generated from the route contracts in shared/contracts/src/http. A refused request answers { error, message }.

get.summary: The workspaces you are a member of, oldest first.

post.summary: Make a workspace, with you as its owner and a #general channel.
Make a demo workspace with example issues, a document, a channel and a meeting, or return the one you already own.

get.summary: One workspace you are a member of.

patch.summary: Rename a workspace or change its theme.

delete.summary: Delete a workspace and everything in it, confirmed with your password.

put.summary: Require two-factor sign-in of everyone in the workspace, or stop; turning it on needs it on your own account.

get.summary: The last 100 things that happened in a workspace, newest first.
A workspace's projects, oldest first, each with its count of open issues.

post.summary: Make a project; its key is derived from the name unless given.

get.summary: One project.

patch.summary: Rename a project, change its description, or archive it.

delete.summary: Delete a project and its issues.

get.summary: A workspace's members, in the order they joined.

post.summary: Invite someone by username (201, the invitation) or by address (202, sent whether or not it has an account).

patch.summary: Change a member's role, within your own authority.

delete.summary: Remove a member, within your own authority.
Leave a workspace; the last owner cannot.

get.summary: Invitations from a workspace that have not been answered.

delete.summary: Withdraw an invitation that has not been answered.

get.summary: The invitations waiting for you, from any workspace.

post.summary: Join the workspace an invitation is for.
Turn an invitation down.

get.summary: The agents' latest changes, newest first: what each set from what to what, and whether it can be undone.

post.summary: Undo an agent's change: put a field back, or remove a comment it wrote; refused once someone has changed it since.

get.summary: What the workspace's agents did: their latest runs step by step, and what people did with their changes.
A workspace's agents and their tokens, for its admins.

post.summary: Add an agent as a member or guest, with a first token shown once.

patch.summary: Rename an agent; its username, tokens and history stay as they are.

delete.summary: Remove an agent: its tokens stop working and it leaves the workspace.

post.summary: Give an agent another token, shown once.

delete.summary: Revoke one of an agent's tokens; the next call carrying it is refused.

post.summary: Record that a hint was used or set aside; nobody is named.

get.summary: How often this workspace's people used each kind of hint, beside the offline evaluation.
A workspace's labels, by name.

post.summary: Make a label; names are unique in a workspace, whatever their case.

delete.summary: Delete a label; it comes off every issue that had it.

put.summary: Set an issue's labels: exactly these, replacing what it had.

get.summary: A project's saved board views, by name.

post.summary: Name and keep a board filter; names are unique in a project whatever their case, and so are filters.

delete.summary: Delete a saved view.

get.summary: Hints for a draft, from one call to the suggestion service: issues it may duplicate, and a suggested priority (or a refusal with the counts it needs, or null for nothing to say).
A page of a project's issues, newest first, with a cursor for the next.

post.summary: File an issue; it takes the next number in its project.

get.summary: One issue, with its labels, the issue it is part of, and its sub-issues.

patch.summary: Change an issue: its title, description, status, priority, assignee, place on the board, due day or parent.

delete.summary: Delete an issue, its comments and its images.

get.summary: An issue's comments, oldest first.

post.summary: Comment on an issue; anyone it @mentions is told.

delete.summary: Delete your own comment, or as an admin, anyone's.

get.summary: The newest chat messages that name this issue by its key, with their rooms.
The issue a key such as REL-4 names in this workspace, in any case.

post.summary: Apply one change to many issues: a status, priority, assignee, a label on or off, or delete. Issues the caller may not change are skipped and reported with the reason.

get.summary: A workspace's documents, most recently changed first.

post.summary: Start a document, in the workspace or under one of its projects.

get.summary: One document, with its text as it stands.

delete.summary: Delete a document and its history.

get.summary: A workspace's channels, by name.

post.summary: Open a channel; its name is normalised, and must be free.

patch.summary: Rename a channel or change its topic.

delete.summary: Delete a channel and its messages.

get.summary: A page of a channel's messages, newest first, with a cursor for the next.

post.summary: Post a message to a channel.
Post a picture to a channel as its own message; re-encoded and stripped of metadata, within the workspace’s storage limit.

delete.summary: Delete your own message, or as an admin, anyone's.

get.summary: Your meetings in a window (at most two days), in every workspace you are in, soonest first; called-off ones left out.
Upcoming meetings, soonest first (and those that ended in the last half hour), or past and called-off ones, latest first.

post.summary: Schedule a meeting; the organiser is an attendee who has said yes.

patch.summary: Change a meeting you organise, or call it off.

delete.summary: Delete a meeting you organise.

post.summary: Say whether you are coming.

get.summary: Your last 100 notifications, newest first, with how many are unread.

post.summary: Mark one notification read.

delete.summary: Dismiss a notification.

post.summary: Mark every notification read.

get.summary: Your notification settings: each kind, on or off in the app, by email and by push.

put.summary: Turn one kind on or off in one channel; returns every setting.

post.summary: What an unsubscribe link would stop, without using it.
Use an unsubscribe link: email off for the kinds it names. Works once.

get.summary: The server's public push key, or null when web push is not set up.

post.summary: Take pushes on this device; a device someone else had moves to you.

delete.summary: Stop pushes to this device.

get.summary: A page of a workspace's audit trail: newest first, or from a sequence number onwards for an export.
Everyone who appears in the trail, members first, former members after.

post.summary: Check the chain, from the last signed checkpoint, or from the start with full=1; names the first bad link.

get.summary: Issues, documents and comments matching a query, best first; one kind with type, more with limit.
The home in one read: every workspace you are in, and the open issues assigned to you.

post.summary: Add an image to an issue, or to one of its comments; it is re-encoded and stripped of metadata, within the workspace's storage limit.

get.summary: An issue's images, its comments' included.

delete.summary: Remove an image you added, or as an admin, any.

post.summary: Make an account from a sign-up link, and sign in.
Sign in; the session is a cookie. With two-factor on, a challenge comes back instead.
Finish a sign-in with a code from the app or a recovery code.
Sign out of this browser.

get.summary: Your own account.

patch.summary: Change your name or username; an old username is held for 90 days.

delete.summary: Delete your account, with your password and a decision for every workspace you alone own (409 lists the undecided).

get.summary: Whether a username can be had, and if not, why.

post.summary: Change your password; every other session ends.

get.summary: Where you are signed in.

delete.summary: Sign out everywhere but here.

get.summary: Whether two-factor sign-in is on, and how many recovery codes are left.

post.summary: Start setting up an authenticator app: a new secret, shown once.
Turn two-factor on with a first code from the app; answers with recovery codes.
Replace every recovery code with a new set.
Turn two-factor off.

get.summary: Your passkeys, without their keys.

post.summary: Finish adding a passkey with the authenticator’s answer.
Start adding a passkey: asks for the password again, and a code too when two-factor is on.

delete.summary: Remove one of your passkeys.

post.summary: Start signing in with a passkey: a challenge for any of them to answer.
Sign in with a passkey’s answer; the session is a cookie.

get.summary: The workspace's stories from the last 24 hours, oldest first.

post.summary: Post a few words as a story.
Post a photo story; it is re-encoded and stripped of metadata, within the workspace’s storage limit.

delete.summary: Take down a story you posted, or as an admin, any.

put.summary: Turn stories on or off for the workspace; owners only. Off hides the ones there are.

get.summary: A member's profile here: title, what they are working on, recent activity the viewer may read, and the images they shared.

patch.summary: Change your title, what you are working on, or whether the Feed may celebrate you, in this workspace.

put.summary: Set the cover photo on your profile here; re-encoded and stripped of metadata.

delete.summary: Remove the cover photo from your profile here.

get.summary: The feed, newest first: posts and pictures from rooms, a page at a time; `seenAt` is where you last caught up.

post.summary: Answer this week's check-in: a post the team sees, and your profile's Working on line here.
Mark the feed caught up to now, for you.
Post a few words to the feed.

Post a photo to the feed; re-encoded and stripped of metadata, within the workspace’s storage. Add words with posts.update. An X-Robis-Meme-Caption header (URI-encoded, up to 80 characters) draws it across the photo as a meme.

patch.summary: Change your post's words, or a photo's caption (empty clears it).

delete.summary: Take down your post, or as an admin, any.

get.summary: A post's comments, oldest first.

post.summary: Comment on a post.

delete.summary: Take down your comment, or as an admin, any.

get.summary: Whom you follow and whom you muted here: yours alone to see.

put.summary: Follow someone here, so the Following feed shows their posts.

delete.summary: Stop following someone here.

put.summary: Hide someone’s posts from your Everyone feed. Nobody is told.

delete.summary: Show someone’s posts on your Everyone feed again.

put.summary: React to a post: celebrate, helpful, support, thanks or insightful.

delete.summary: Take back a reaction.

get.summary: How each active project is doing, from its issues: open, done in the last seven days, overdue, urgent, and a state worked out from those (needs a look, on track, quiet or finished).
Milestones from the last seven days worth a well done: a project finished, an issue milestone, an anniversary, a new teammate. Never for anyone who turned celebrations off, nor for agents.

put.summary: React to one of this week’s celebrations, the same reactions a post has.

delete.summary: Take back a reaction to a celebration.

get.summary: Every space in the workspace, the most recently active first.

post.summary: Start a space: a topic for threads, named once per workspace.

get.summary: A space’s threads: most recently active, newest, most reacted to, or questions with no answer yet.

post.summary: Start a thread in a space: a question, an idea, a discussion or a tip.

get.summary: A thread and its replies, oldest first, each with the reply it answers.

delete.summary: Take down a thread you started, or as an admin, any, with its replies.

post.summary: Reply to a thread, or to a reply in it.

delete.summary: Take down a reply you wrote, or as an admin, any. Its words go; the replies under it stay.

put.summary: Mark the reply that answered a question, or clear it: for whoever asked, or an admin.
React to a thread or a reply in a space.

delete.summary: Take back a reaction in a space.

put.summary: Follow a space, so its new threads come to your Following feed.

delete.summary: Stop following a space.

get.summary: The most helpful people and replies across every space: Helpful marks received and answers given, this week, this month or of all time.
The open issues assigned to you in this workspace, soonest due first, then by priority: what the Today page groups.
Each active project's cycle time and weekly throughput over twelve weeks, from status changes.
This workspace's hint acceptance and, for the server's operators, its job queue and a day of sync lag and live-update latency.
Whether you have a calendar feed, and since when; never its address.

post.summary: Make your calendar feed, replacing any other; its address is shown this once.

delete.summary: Revoke your calendar feed: its address answers 404 from now on.

post.summary: Schedule the meetings in an .ics file, invitees matched to the roster by address; what cannot be taken is listed with why.

get.summary: The workspace's automation rules, with a month of their runs by outcome.

post.summary: Add an automation rule: a trigger, conditions that must all hold, and one action.

patch.summary: Change a rule, or turn it off or on.

delete.summary: Remove a rule; what it already did stays in the trail.

get.summary: A rule's last fifty runs, newest first, with any note (a chain stopped, an action that failed).
The workspace's meeting occurrences in a window of at most nine days, and the issues due on the dates it covers.

post.summary: Start signing up: a link goes to the address, and the answer is the same whether or not it has an account.
Ask for a reset link. Always 202, whatever was sent, so the answer never says whether an address has an account.
Set a new password from a reset link; every session ends.
From a new-device alert: it was not me. Every session ends and every browser is forgotten.
Confirm your address from the link that was mailed to it.
Mail the confirmation link again, unless the address is confirmed already.
Agree to the current terms.
Keep the username an account was given, once asked.

get.summary: A page of your own account's trail: sign-ins, password and username changes.

post.summary: Check your account trail's chain; names the first bad link.

put.summary: Use a photo as your picture; it is re-encoded small and stripped of metadata.
Use a generated picture, drawn by the web app from its seed.

get.summary: The latest exports of this workspace, newest first. Admins only.

post.summary: Ask for an export of everything the workspace owns; built by a job. Refused while one is being built. Admins only.
A download address for a ready export: it works once, for 5 minutes, and only signed in as an admin of the workspace. Making another replaces it.
Import issues from a CSV file whose first row names its columns (title, description, status, priority, labels, id).
Import a GitHub repository's issues (not its pull requests), with labels and comments. The token, for a private repository or a higher rate limit, is used for this import alone and never kept.
Import the issues of a Robis workspace export, with their labels and comments, into this board.

get.summary: The workspace's outgoing webhooks, never their secrets. Admins only.

post.summary: Add an outgoing webhook for chosen events; its signing secret is in this answer and never again. Admins only.

patch.summary: Turn a webhook on or off, or change its events. Admins only.

delete.summary: Remove a webhook and its delivery log. Admins only.

get.summary: A webhook's latest deliveries, with each one's attempts and last answer. Admins only.
Your live personal access tokens, never their secrets, with when each was last used.

post.summary: Make a personal access token, with your password: read only, or read and write. Its secret is in this answer and never again.

delete.summary: Revoke one of your tokens; the next request that carries it is refused.

get.summary: Whether this workspace is connected to GitHub, and how. Admins only.

post.summary: Connect to GitHub, or make a new secret: the secret for the repository webhook is in this answer and never again. Admins only.

patch.summary: Choose whether merging a linked pull request moves the issue to done. Admins only.

delete.summary: Disconnect from GitHub; its webhook is refused from then on. Admins only.

get.summary: The pull requests that name this issue's key, with each one's state.
